name: Bitwarden
author: user
description: Bitwarden password manager integration for the Omarchy status bar and quick access panel.

barWidget.description: Search logins, copy passwords & TOTP codes, and manage your Bitwarden vault directly from the bar.

schema.label: Auto-lock timeout (minutes)
schema.description: Lock vault automatically after minutes of inactivity (0 to disable)

schema.label: Clear clipboard timeout (seconds)
schema.description: Automatically clear copied password/TOTP from clipboard after seconds (0 to disable)

schema.label: Remember session in OS keyring
schema.description: Store session key in libsecret OS keyring while unlocked
